notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157905/b7064a323d95780fa28e54b8a9af47758b6f1ac4.png[/img]

Hey rebels,

We're back with a tiny patch today to fix compatibility issues on certain monitors: 

[h1]Resolution Hotfix - Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] 🤘 1440p resolution can now be properly displayed on non-16:9 monitors (e.g. ultrawide).
[/list]

xoxo
Studio Fizbin

notes.title: Version 1.0.1: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157905/b7064a323d95780fa28e54b8a9af47758b6f1ac4.png[/img]
Hey rebels,

Thanks for your kinds words since Reignbreaker launched nearly 3 weeks ago! With your help, we've been working hard to catch and squish any remaining bugs.

[b]PLUS: [/b]We've added an FAQ to our Community Hub! A number of players have reported similar issues that are not due to game bugs, so if your're experiencing an issue not covered by this patch, please check our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2129810/discussions/0/604152794750972274/]pinned post here[/url] first.

[h1]Patch Notes - Version 1.0.1[/h1]
[b]Note:[/b] 🤘 means this change was made in response to community feedback!
[h2]General Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🤘 Added UI when entering the Bastion that displays the number of raids successfully completed
[*] 🤘 Improved colliders on spike traps so dashing over them is more predictable
[*] 🤘 Players can now successfully complete time challenges if they reach the safe room in the final second
[*] 🤘 Changing your equipped Javelins in a certain order no longer causes strange firing behavior
[*] 🤘 Enemies no longer spawn behind large obstacles
[*] Rebalanced certain time challenge goals for unlocking new javelins
[*] Clef now properly respawns by her tent after defeating the final boss
[*] Inactivate Fuse Boxes no longer play sound effects when a different Fuse Box in the area is triggering
[*] Fixed a line of dialogue that displayed incorrect character art for Evangeline
[*] Walking during the loading screen into camp no longer skips dialogue with Evangeline
[*] Fixed bug causing bomb traps to spawn in incorrect configurations
[*] Fixed incorrect stat increases being displayed for leveling up items while having both [b]Swift Maneuver[/b] and [b]Through the Chest[/b] equipped
[*] Fixed rare instance of post-combat popups not appearing
[*] [b]Tea Leaves[/b] item now always increases max health by the listed amount
[*] Clef's character art no longer disappears at the end of her first chat with the Trenchrat
[*] Trap activation SFX no longer plays on repeat if Clef dies while activating a trap
[*] Improved Chimera animations in its shotgun firing mode
[*] Various small visual fixes in environments
[*] Save animation is now visible in loading screens
[*] Reduced SFX volume for dropping bear traps
[*] Fixed rare instances of Spreadballs becoming invincible
[*] Fixed numerous missing sound effects in the final boss
[*] Fixed item rarity labels displaying the wrong color
[*] Fixed certain UI elements still showing with the HUD turned off
[*] Added explosion SFX to the final boss's death
[*] Tutorial box images updated to match current look of game
[*] Improved the fog appearance in chamber exits
[*] The Trenchrat can now appear in the first run
[*] Music no longer cuts off after reducing the final boss's health to 0
[*] Improved security camera visuals
[*] If the player defeats the final boss while the Javelin is overheated, the SFX no longer play throughout the epilogue and credits
[*] Improved the hitbox of enemy spawn-in damage
[/list]
Thanks for playing, and please keep the feedback coming in our Steam forums!

xoxo
Studio Fizbin

notes.title: Demo Update: Version 1.0.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45157905/2ec919a986a30b325f3ddfee1303e3b96cea60af.png[/img]
Hey rebels,

Thanks for an amazing launch week for [i]Reignbreaker[/i]! [b]We are hard at work building & testing the first patch for the main game[/b], but in the meantime we decided to push a small update to our demo, which will remain available for the forseeable future. We made a huge number of improvements & bug fixes between the release of the demo and the release of the main game, so we wanted to give the demo a little love to make sure it runs as smoothly as the actual game.

[b]Please note that the majority of these bugs were already fixed before we we released the complete game![/b] We do plan to release the patch for the full game in the second week of April, so stay tuned!

[h1]Patch Notes - Demo Version 1.0.1[/h1]
[b]Note:[/b] 🤘 means this change was made in response to community feedback!
[h2General Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🤘 General performance improvements to address game stuttering issues
[*] 🤘 Dialogue no longer auto-progresses by default
[*] 🤘 Save files now properly display the number of raid attempts
[*] Enemies will no longer spawn behind large obstacles
[*] Improved the lighting effect of the security cameras
[*] Fixed issue where lockdowns would sometimes require two interactions with the Lock to start
[*] Evangeline will no longer appear as "anonymous" in certain dialogues
[*] Fixed sometimes skipping Evangeline's dialogue when returning to lobby
[*] Fixed the flickering lights in certain rooms
[*] Prevented save icon & loading text from disappearing during loading screens
[*] Fixed bug that prevented acid Spreadballs from being killable
[*] Fixed Vault Item rarities sometimes displaying the wrong color
[*] Various small improvements in lighting, set dressing, & Z-fighting in levels
[*] Increased hitbox of enemy spawning damage to match visuals
[*] Fixed rare bug in which a player could be locked in a room after failing a time challenge
[*] Preservation item now always displays correct healing amount
[*] Hellgrunts no longer get confused and walk in place when the player stands in a corner
[*] Clef no longer loses health when player uses the healing station while they have scratch damage
[*] Fixed incorrectly displayed stats on [b]Spin Blades[/b] Vault Item
[*] Exiting game after arriving late to the Javelin unlock station no longer resets the clock
[*] Upgrading "Uncommon" Vault Items now always display correct stat values
[*] Prevented damage numbers from displaying incorrect colors
[*] Spikeballs can no longer exit the lockdown area if the player is standing close to the boundary
[*] Execution icon no longer clips into enemies or the player
[*] [b]Tea Leaves[/b] item now properly heals player
[*] Reloading a room after saving & quitting no longer changes what Vaults are available
[*] [b]Tagged Territory[/b] paint puddles no longer cast large shadows
[*] Equipping both [b]Blood for Blood[/b] and [b]Lancer Boots[/b] no longer makes player invincible to ranged attacks even when not aiming
[*] Slam attacks now properly land critical hits
[*] Flamethrower turrets now properly display their shadows when spawning
[*] Prevented rare issue that caused the game to freeze while Saving & Quitting from camp
[*] Security cameras no longer move after being deactivated
[*] Root now properly applies to common Overseer enemies
[*] Fixed rare bug that caused the Overseer boss to stop attacking
[*] [b]Out of Pocket[/b] now works correctly when Clef is hit by her own Blast Javelin explosions
[*] Reduced frequency of "Javelin overheating" shouts
[*] Fixed inconsistent trap behavior when an enemy dies on a spike trap
[*] Fixed alignment of [b]Paint Slash [/b]VFX
[*] Items available in the pop-up item shops no longer change after reloading the game
[*] [b]Bleed Together[/b] projectiles no longer target offscreen enemies
[*] Screen no longer shakes when Clef walks between the dumbbells in camp
[*] Acid from hellgrunts is no longer hidden by unactivated Gearboxes
[*] Increased size scaling of damage numbers
[*] Fixed issue in which character illustrations during dialogues would be partially opaque
[*] Made VFX for Slam attacks more consistent in different contexts
[*] Clef now always spawns into rooms facing the correct direction
[*] Fixed Railgun VFX disappearing when player opens a menu
[*] Added controller vibration when enemies take damage from Railgun bayonets
[*] Fixed controller vibration not occurring when certain enemies are hit
[*] [b]Coated Crowd[/b] item now works as intended
[*] Clef no longer gets stuck facing in one direction after punching an enemy to death
[*] Removed flickering VFX from the Overseer's knife attack
[*] Players can no longer enter gravestone clusters
[*] Clef no longer occasionally has two shadows
[*] Dash VFX can no longer appear in loading screens
[*] [b]Spin Blades[/b] can no longer be triggered too early
[*] Prevent enemies from spawning out of bounds during Chimera fight
[*] Improved Chimera animations during its shotgun mode
[*] Chimera can no longer be permanently stunned
[*] Enemies no longer walk in place briefly after exiting pause menu
[/list]
[h3]UI Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated UI icons in the tutorial popups
[*] Peashooter projectiles no longer flicker while UI is open
[*] Vault Item names no longer overflow their text boxes when large fonts are activated
[*] Long item names no longer overflow onto level up indicator in the Power Shop
[*] Fixed localized texts not being properly displayed in certain scenarios or when switching languages
[*] Fixed loading screen icons being low resolution
[*] Players no longer receive duplicate messages after shop items are used up
[*] Added an "Are you sure?" prompt when quitting the game or giving up a run in the pause menu
[*] Prevented issue that caused keyword details to remain visible after closing inventory
[*] Fixed incorrect subtitles being displayed during Clef's shouts in camp
[*] Run time on victory screens now properly displays the actual time
[*] Added heat icon to Hot & Cold upgrade
[*] Switching between keyboard/mouse & controller when an item is selected no longer changes the name & item description
[*] Item names no longer disappear when scrolling between items
[*] Improved scrolling behavior in the Javelin Armoury
[*] Fixed background issues in Controls & Settings menus
[*] Holding input button while selecting audio sliders no longer sets the wrong values
[*] Fixed instances in certain level layouts in which item pickup prompts would not appear
[*] Volume bar display now properly matches percentage
[*] Fixed Clef getting stuck facing one direction after Executions
[*] Player can no longer lock on to broken statues
[*] Prevent tutorials for specific items from overlapping
[*] [b]Calm and Collected[/b] item behavior now matches description
[*] Swapping languages during combat now works properly
[*] Fixed order of Javelin details in results screen
[/list]
[h3]Sound Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Pain Point [/b]SFX can no longer be heard when volume is set to 0%
[*] Healing station SFX can no longer be heard when volume is set to 0%
[*] Railgun SFX can no longer be heard when volume is set to 0%
[*] Blast SFX can no longer be heard when volume is set to 0%
[*] Baby bellgrunt sounds can no longer be heard while in menus
[*] First punch of combo with Punch Rush upgrade now properly plays SFX
[*] Improved volume balance between dialogue in cutscenes and in levels
[*] Added SFX to Bridge Lock being unlocked
[*] All traps now properly have SFX
[*] Balanced the volume of SFX related to Vault Items
[*] Fixed music playing improperly during Chimera fight
[*] Chimera attack SFX now trigger correctly
[*] Added SFX to player death
[*] All explosions now have SFX
[*] Fist bumping the Baby Bellgrunt no longer triggers the Queen's dialogue
[*] Better synced treasure sounds with Vault opening
[*] Added SFX to resurrections
[/list]
Thanks for playing, and please keep the feedback coming in our Steam forums!

xoxo
Studio Fizbin

notes.title: Dev Diary #5: Music & Audio
notes.content:
[h3]DEVSTREAM TODAY![/h3]
First things first: don’t miss our final pre-launch devstream TODAY, March 12, at 15:00 CET with one of our audio designers, who will be chatting about how his team crafted the unique medievalpunk soundscape of Reigbnreaker. [url=https://www.twitch.tv/studiofizbin]Follow us on Twitch[/url] and don’t miss it!

[h2]WHAT DOES MEDIEVALPUNK SOUND LIKE?[/h2]
Reignbreaker is medievalpunk game. Yes, we made up this word, but we like it because it captures the wild mashup of aesthetics and influences that feed into the game. That extends from the gameplay to the art to our focus today: sound design. "It was quite a process to find the right balance of punch, punk, and medieval soundscapes to represent the game’s anti-establishment direction,” says Markus Zierhofer of AudioCreatures, who created the audio for Reignbreaker. “Shaping the audio landscape, our entire team contributed to the audio direction, sound design, and music — destroying and recording countless guitars, and experimenting with various sounds through re-sampling and re-amping techniques to bring the world to life.”

AudioCreatures used both modern and medieval instruments to match the anachronistic influences of Reignbreaker, while also setting the mood: “We kept the music punchy while also adding melodic sequences in the combat music, which are tailored to match the enemies you’re fighting to create a cohesive and immersive game world”

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WF8l1xE.gif[/img]
[i]The Reignbreaker title track can be heard in the main menu — play the demo to listen now![/i]

[h2]GETTING THE BAND TOGETHER[/h2]
But the game still needed a punk rock anthem to get players in the mood to fight: “From the start, we really wanted to collaborate with an established punk band or artist,” says Markus, “and we were thrilled to arrange an extremely cool partnership for the game's title track. We're officially announcing and releasing the track onto streaming platforms on March 14 — but if you've played the demo and done some digging you probably who it is already. We're super pleased with the result, which is not only a perfect match for the game but also an absolute banger on its own!"

[h2]WEAPON SPOTLIGHT: BLAST[/h2]
Finally, let's highlight the final and most [i][b]chaotic [/b][/i]Javelin bayonet in our series: the [b]Blast Javelin[/b]. Basically, it makes your weapon explode on impact. This does a lot of damage to enemies, but it can damage you as well. Therefore it carries a very high risk of injury, but it’s (almost) always worth it.

Keep your distance while blasting enemy groups with the [b]Throw[/b]:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/2M7jvpV.gif[/img]
The [b]Strike [/b]is a dive attack that plants a bomb, which goes off after a short time:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/hm80M5H.gif[/img]
And the [b]Slam [/b]explodes right where you're standing — so make sure to dash away ASAP:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cZ5sqaa.gif[/img]
[h2]LAUNCHING NEXT TUESDAY[/h2]
Hey, so this is crazy, but we’re launching the game in less than a week. Please check out our demo if you haven’t yet, tell your friends, and tune in to our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/studiofizbin]Twitch channel[/url] later today for our last pre-launch devstream!

xoxo
Studio Fizbin

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes (+ a Giveaway!)
notes.content:
Hey Reignbreakers,

It's been amazing seeing so many people play our demo in the last week! We've already reached thousands of players and over 50 positive reviews, giving us a Very Positive rating on Steam — thank you so much for your incredible response and for leaving your reviews! It helps us a lot. <3

Many of you have also provided lots of feedback and reports, so we've made a few adjustments to improve our demo and just released a patch. Thanks for all your feedback so far, and please keep it coming in the Steam Community Hub — it helps us make our demo & game as good as they can be!

See below for the full notes, and scroll to the bottom for info on a sick new [b][url=https://gleam.io/EAdEo/reignbreaker-artwork-game-key-giveaway]giveaway[/url] of exclusive art[/b]!

[h1]Patch Notes - Version 0.9.1[/h1]

[b]Note:[/b] 🤘 means this change was made in response to community feedback!
[h2]Balancing Changes[/h2]

[b]PUNCH[/b]
[list]
[*] 🤘 Increased punch impact feeling
[*] Slightly increased base range to better match visual
[*] Increased stagger of first punch
[*] Reduced knockback of first punch
[/list]
[b]JAVELIN[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased [b]Shotgun [/b]strike damage from 10 to 13
[*] Reduced [b]Shotgun [/b]strike heat cost from 15 to 13
[*] Increased [b]Shotgun [/b]throw damage from 13 to 15 [/list]
[b]VAULT ITEMS[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased [b]Acid Coat [/b]damage from 8 to 10
[*] Increased [b]Power Slam[/b] damage increase from 15% to 45%
[*] Increased [b]Calm and Collected[/b] heat recovery from 18 to 20
[*] 🤘 Removed screen shake effect from [b]Spraycans[/b] that are not triggered manually
[/list]
[b]SHOP ITEMS[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced[b] Leather Armour[/b] damage reduction from 15% to 10%
[*] Reduced [b]Steel Armour [/b]damage reduction form 20% to 15%
[/list]
[b]ENEMIES[/b]
[list]
[*] 🤘 Added the ability to stagger some enemies during their attack start-ups
[*] Fixed some attacks using higher damage profiles than intended on the Chimera
[*] Reduced projectile speed on Chimera Shotgun attacks
[*] Reduced hitbox of electric area in Chimera fight to better match the visuals
[/list]
[b]STATUS EFFECTS[/b]
[list]
[*] Rooted duration increased from 2 seconds to 3 seconds
[*] Slow effects now linger for 1.5 seconds after leaving slow areas
[/list]
[b]GENERAL[/b]
[list]
[*] 🤘 Reduced amount of time it takes for Vault Items to spawn after combat
[*] 🤘 Path to upgrade station in camp is clearer
[*] 🤘 Locked permanent character upgrade slots are now visible, so that players can see how many they can equip in the full release
[*] 🤘 Level Up statue and Healing Statue have more distinct visuals
[*] 🤘 Added a new upgrade to the demo - enjoy taking advantage of the [b]Punch Rush[/b] combo!
[*] 🤘 Added an additional character upgrade slot
[*] 🤘 Changed character upgrade resolve prices (demo only)
[*] 🤘 Damage number sizes are smaller when damage is lower
[*] Changed invincibility after taking a hit to include the duration the player is in hit-stop
[*] Additional Javelin unlocks via exploration are more frequent
[*] Changed attack input recognition to allow for more directional control for most attacks
[*] Enemies can now be knocked back while initiating attacks
[*] Reduced required combo score to get to max combo level
[*] 🤘 Adjusted audio mixing levels during combat and dialogue
[*] Explosive barrel traps can now be triggered by enemy projectiles
[*] Desktop and Steam icons have been updated
[*] Background of pause and main menu screens fades faster
[*] Reduced the required combo score to reach max level
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🤘 Optimizations to reduce game stuttering and performance improvements
[*] 🤘 Fixed keyboard and mouse controls overlapping in Controls menu
[*] 🤘 Fixed compatibility issues with Dualsense controllers
[*] Dead enemies no longer block Javelin throws
[*] Clef will no longer get stuck facing in a single direction while running
[*] Health bar no longer persists into death screen
[*] Run timer now properly pauses when players pause the game
[*] UI sounds play properly when using a directional pad
[*] "Follow us" text in main menu is properly localized
[*] Fixed issue where swapping input methods would hide state upgrades
[*] Removed debug tools that could be accessed in the demo 
[*] Fixed main menu background occasionally not appearing
[*] Javelin can no longer be thrown through environmental obstacles
[*] Action checks now properly disappear when player leaves training area
[*] Fixed UI inconsistency that made dash upgrades appear inaccessible
[*] Removed delay when moving between main menu tabs
[*] Fixed debris effect from enemy spawns sometimes looping
[*] Fixed attacks sometimes not facing the direction of player input
[*] Fixed ripple effect from picking up Vault Item sometimes obscuring menu text
[*] Fixed healing station giving inconsistent health amounts when reloading save
[*] [b]Deep Cut[/b] now properly reduces damage from bleeding enemies
[*] Tutorial text no longer reappears after reloading saves
[*] Fixed tutorial UI overlapping each other
[*] Fixed turret enemies sometimes walking in place
[*] "Boss Defeated" notification no longer covers dialogue & character animations
[*] Added checkmark in Javelin Armoury to show which Javelin is equipped
[*] Fixed wonky inventory screen navigation
[*] Fixed incorrect combat SFX timings after repeatedly using the same moves
[*] Safe room time challenge no longer displays as failed when the player has successfully completed the challenge
[*] Fixed minor visual bugs in environment
[*] Fixed parts of the Settings UI not being clickable
[*] Fixed infinite loading screen caused by dialogue triggering while pause menu is open
[*] Pause menu can no longer be opened while defeat screen is displayed
[*] Fixed performance issues caused by repeated Railgun Slams
[*] Fixed overlapping text in run result screen in certain languages
